model_output.cross_horizon_summary: Current evidence favors downside over 12h and 72h, but does not establish a dependable 168h net-direction edge. Broad negative participation, fresh hourly declines, ETH-relative weakness and contracting stablecoin supply outweigh modest positive BTC settled flows and localized absorption signals. Rebounds remain plausible; neither absorption nor stabilization would establish recovery or broad altcoin transmission. These forecasts are independently inferred from supplied observations, not copied from the structural MIXED prior. Transmission classifications describe currently observed recovery participation, not guaranteed future conditions. This is non-binding descriptive analysis with no execution authority or changes to framework thresholds or weights.

Downside risk remains elevated despite the absence of a sufficiently supported weekly directional edge.
